description: NIIT takes the rental net AFTER § 168 depreciation: $275,000 building placed in service in January, 3.485% = $9,583.75, so the rental net is $40,000 − $9,583.75 = $30,416.25. Single, wages $230,000: MAGI $260,416.25, excess $60,416.25; NIIT = 3.8% × $30,416.25 = $1,155.82, $1,156 on Form 8960 line 17.
